headline: Hurricane Season Ready: Treasure Coast Essentials to Consider
affiliate_disclosure: Treasure Coast Today may earn a commission from qualifying purchases made through links in this article.
intro: Hurricane preparation is easier when the basics are gathered before a storm is approaching. These products cover communication, backup power and lighting.

products.name: Example Emergency Weather Radio
products.label: Best Overall
products.summary: A compact emergency radio that can receive weather alerts and provide backup lighting during an outage.

products.name: Example Portable Power Station
products.label: Best for Power Outages
products.summary: A portable battery unit for phones, lights and other small essentials when household power is unavailable.

closing: Build supplies gradually, keep batteries charged and review your household hurricane plan before the busiest part of the season.
